info.title: Zhishu AI API
info.description: OpenAPI contract for the Zhishu AI knowledge-base QA backend. The chat stream endpoint returns Server-Sent Events.

get.description: Checks app readiness. In MySQL mode this performs a lightweight SELECT 1 dependency check.

post.summary: Login and receive a JWT access token
post.description: Authenticates a user and returns a Bearer token. Mock mode accepts the configured mock admin credentials.

get.description: Returns the current user's safe identity fields for restoring admin/frontend session state.

post.description: Records an auth_logout audit event. JWT logout is stateless; clients should discard the access token locally.

post.summary: Stream a chat answer with safety, agent decision, RAG retrieval, and generation events
post.description: Returns Server-Sent Events. Each event is emitted as `data: {json}\n\n`.

value.temporaryContext: 智枢AI支持把临时OCR内容用于本轮问答。

post.summary: Complete upload and create an ingest task

delete.summary: Delete a file and its vector chunks

get.description: Returns recent dashboard distributions for admin chart widgets. days supports 1-90 and defaults to 7.

Returns safe audit/security aggregates for admin widgets. Raw prompts, full message content, retrieved context, embeddings, storage paths, passwords, tokens, Authorization headers, stack traces, and internal payloads are excluded.
Returns one safety or operational audit log. Raw prompts, retrieved context, stack traces, secrets, and internal payloads are not returned.
Returns paginated feedback details with messagePreview for admin review.
Returns one feedback record with the related message preview and conversation summary. Full raw answer text and RAG context are not returned.
Returns paginated chat messages with contentPreview for admin troubleshooting.

Returns one message preview with related conversation summary, RAG query logs, feedback records, and safe model call summaries. Full raw message text, prompts, provider payloads, and retrieved context are not returned.
Returns paginated conversation summaries with message count and lastMessagePreview.
Returns one conversation summary and up to 50 recent message previews. Full raw message content is intentionally not returned.
Returns paginated knowledge files with status, ingest mode, and chunkCount for admin review.
Returns one knowledge file and its related ingest tasks. Internal storage paths are intentionally excluded.
Returns one ingest task and its related knowledge file summary.
Returns one RAG retrieval log and the related user message preview. Raw vector embeddings are not returned.
Returns one model call log and the related conversation summary. Raw prompt and context text are not returned.

Returns aggregate user activity metrics and recent operational records for an admin user detail page. Raw prompts, full messages, retrieved context, embeddings, storage paths, stack traces, and secrets are intentionally excluded.

Returns one user's safe audit/security timeline with aggregate counts, distributions, and paginated audit previews. Raw prompts, full messages, retrieved context, embeddings, storage paths, passwords, tokens, Authorization headers, stack traces, and internal payloads are excluded.
Returns paginated users for the admin user table. Credential fields such as password_hash are never returned.
Returns one safe user profile for admin detail pages. Password hashes are never returned.

patch.description: Enables or disables another user account. Requires admin:users:read and admin:users:write. The current admin user cannot disable their own account.

get.description: Returns daily dashboard trend points for admin charts. days supports 1-90 and defaults to 7.

accessToken.description: JWT access token. Do not log or expose this value.
